title: We look at more than marks
lead: Your plan takes your whole situation into account. Here is what we know and what it changes.
private: Kept private. Used only to add disability scholarships and accessible courses.

place.title: Where you live
place.known: Colleges, jobs and schemes near {{place}} come first.
place.near_home: Only options you can reach from {{place}}.
place.city: Options near {{place}} and in cities in your state.
place.abroad: Options in India now, and scholarships to study abroad after your degree.

money.title: Money at home
money.earn: Earn-while-you-learn paths and scholarships come first.
money.study: Full-time study paths, with every scholarship you qualify for.

age.title: Your age
age.minor: Under 18: only work the law allows at your age. Scholarships and skills before jobs.
age.adult: 18 or over: jobs and apprenticeships are included.

access.title: Phone and internet
access.limited: Short lessons you can save and use without internet.
access.good: Videos and live features are included.

family.title: Family and time
family.business: Paths that build on your family's work.
family.time: Steps sized to the time you have each week.

disability.title: Disability or health needs
disability.yes: Disability scholarships and accessible courses are added.

interests.title: Interests and skills
interests.effect: Careers are ranked by what you enjoy and can already do.
